_note: Literary works. Every entry was checked against the listed source on 7 Nov 2026. To add a book: copy an entry, put the cover in site/assets/covers/, run the build.

publications.title: Wheat for the Living
publications.text: In the small Bulgarian town of Belogradets, Yavor Velev grows up between a family that lives for appearances and one that keeps score, and slowly learns that being useful, or admired, is not the same as being worth something.

publications.title: The Attic Record
publications.text: Lindenfeld, August 1958. Sent to the attic for a tablecloth, a seven-year-old finds an old gramophone and listens alone to Haydn’s “Emperor” Quartet. Decades later, after his mother’s funeral, he learns what that afternoon meant to her.

books.title: Tales from Bellavere and Lindenfeld
books.synopsis: Linked stories from two small European towns that appear on no map. Across generations, families pass down loyalties, recipes, music, houses, debts and secrets: a mechanic, a chocolatier, a struggling theatre company, a singing palazzo, and a boy changed by a forgotten gramophone record.
books.edition: October 2026 edition; the ebook is distributed through Draft2Digital

books.title: The Debt of the Fifth Month
books.synopsis: A novella in eleven movements, set in Italy. After the death of their thirteen-year-old son, Matteo and Elena Valli bring nine estranged cousins back to one table, while money they never asked for begins to arrive. A story of grief, faith and family.
books.note: The story begins with the death of a child.

books.title: August 18th
books.synopsis: A literary thriller narrated from the small Deccan town of Suloor. One violent night, on 18 August 1996, sets off consequences that return on the same date across the following decades.

books.title: GOTTESGABE: God’s Gift
books.synopsis: Königswinter, 1923 to 1973. A secret chocolate recipe, passed from a grieving Belgian chocolatier to a German soldier, survives a family factory, betrayal, a killing and eighteen years in prison.

books.title: Kamil & Hassan Drama Company
books.synopsis: Belgium in the 1920s. Two men leave a famous theatre company to found their own troupe, a marketer turns the actors’ fame into a business, and when cinema arrives, a long-silent love and an act of violence change two lives.

books.title: The House on the Hill Above the River
books.synopsis: A Bulgarian family saga of vanity, sacrifice and awakening, from the town of Belogradets to the Bulgarian parishes of Vienna, about a man caught between two families and his own need for approval.

books.title: Ten Tales from Bellavere and Lindelfeld
books.synopsis: The first, ten-story paperback from the same two towns, five from each, later expanded as Tales from Bellavere and Lindenfeld. The title is listed as printed.
